arms.conditional: Input-conditioned mixture with the original absolute, paired and flat objective
arms.constant: Fitted global expert weights with frozen expert corrections
arms.gap-supervised: Same conditional head, plus twice the paired spatial gap error and once the absolute gap error

training.optimizer: AdamW, .001 to .0001 cosine, 24-update warmup, weight decay .001, per-head gradient cap 2.

weights: EMA for all reported primary comparisons; raw weights and their numerical results are archived.
